name: effect-pixel-mosaic
title: Pixel Mosaic Resolve
description: Chữ hoặc khối hình bị khảm ô vuông lớn rồi rõ dần qua sáu nấc 32 → 1 px, mỗi nấc 120 ms, không chuyển mượt.

moworks.author: takayu

options.blocks: block sizes in px, coarse to sharp ([96, 48, 24, 12, 6, 1])
options.exitStep: s per step on the way out (0.08)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-pixel-mosaic, written here): Text (or box) pixelated with block size 32 → 16 → 8 → 4 → 2 → 1 px, 6 hard steps of 120 ms (hold keys, smoothing off); letterforms become legible in the last two steps; reverse for an exit. Demo: 32 px held until 0.3 s, resolved by 0.78 s; exit steps back up at 80 ms each from 2.4 s; loop 3.2 s. Params: steps: các cỡ ô (32 / 16 / 8 / 4 / 2 / 1 px) · step: mỗi nấc (0.12 s) · exit: mỗi nấc khi rời (0.08 s). The site's steps are 32 → 1 px on a small frame; here the blocks are scaled to large type. Letters read only in the last two steps.
moworks.titleVi: Khảm điểm ảnh rõ dần theo nấc
